name: Control Chart (Rare Events)
description: g and t charts for rare events
whenToUse: Monitor rare events: the g chart counts opportunities between events, the t chart the time between events.
typeHint_g: Geometrically distributed count of units between two events.
typeHint_t: Time span between events with the Nelson power transform.
dataHint_t: Column of time spans between events (positive values).
originalScaleNote: KPIs on the original scale (back-transformed); chart on the transformed scale.
